column1: # Dated events for the variables of the summer-1939 crisis sub-game (docs/ontology_crisis_1939.md)

# Rows whose level equals the level in force are dated confirming observations. "(not verified)" in the note marks a date
# or reference recalled but not checked against the document. Rows before 5 Jul 1939 defend the initial levels.
